description: This file defines a PHP class 'ADODB2_sapdb' that extends 'ADODB_DataDict' to provide database schema management functionalities specifically for SAP DB within the ADOdb PHP library.

classes.name: ADODB2_sapdb
classes.description: A data dictionary class for managing SAP DB schema operations such as data type conversion, adding, altering, or dropping columns in tables.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Converts metadata types to SAP DB actual types, supporting custom meta types.

methods.name: MetaType
methods.description: Maps generic PHP/ADOdb types to database-specific type codes, considering length and auto-increment properties.

methods.name: _createSuffix
methods.description: Generates SQL suffixes for column attributes like NOT NULL, DEFAULT, UNSIGNED, and constraints.

methods.name: AddColumnSQL
methods.description: Constructs SQL statement to add columns to a table.

methods.name: AlterColumnSQL
methods.description: Constructs SQL statement to modify existing columns in a table.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Constructs SQL statement to drop columns from a table.
